review.assessment: This change creates makeGrid by using .fill() with a pre-constructed inner array, which populates every row slot with a reference to that single shared object rather than independent arrays. Consequently, any mutation to one cell propagates to all rows, failing the stated requirement for independent grids. The existing acceptance test passed likely because it omitted checks for cross-row mutation side-effects.

findings.defect: All rows share the same array reference due to incorrect use of .fill().
